osSearch.title: Notes in the system search
osSearch.switch: Show this vault's notes in Spotlight or Windows Search
osSearch.note: Only the title, a short excerpt, the tags and a link go in. Locked, encrypted, private and hidden notes never do. Turning this off deletes everything Lumen put in the system search for this vault.
osSearch.perVault: This choice is for this vault only.
osSearch.cleared: This vault's notes were removed from the system search.
osSearch.failed: Could not change the system search: {error}
